A 3-day mini-course

Gently feel your Polyvagal states in 3 days

Discover your nervous system states, gently notice them in action, and build awareness through this guided mini-course.

Buy for $1

What to expect

Over three days, you'll get a short lesson and a guided practice each day to help you recognize and engage with your states. On the fourth day, we'll reflect on your experience and build on your progress.

The course is gentle and exploratory. Come from curiosity, put your well-being first, and take it one step at a time.

Why this course

You've been learning about Polyvagal Theory and you're curious about your own states. Maybe you feel stuck in your body's defenses, or you wonder how all this applies to you.

Instead of trying to figure it out alone, you'll gently notice your nervous system in action, with curiosity and self-compassion.
